Name: AT Princess Peach's Castle
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
as a lover of princess peach and feeling inspired after seeing the new mario movie, i had the idea to make a princess peach castle mod  ♡

. ☆  . • ☆ . ° .• °:. *₊ ° . ☆

[img]https://imgur.com/4pncZL1.png[/img]
1. download and install alternative textures
2. download this mod
3. unzip folder into stardew's mod folder

[img]https://imgur.com/e6yXfxu.png[/img]
♡ to use, purchase the paint bucket from robin and use it on your farmhouse (must be fully upgraded) to change it to either one of the two versions: normal and pink
♡ mod also comes with a recipe for princess peach's cake as a housewarming gift~
♡ ignore the hatch that is installed on the house in both pictures, that is where silly the slime (from the adventurer's guild expanded mod) lives. if silly doesnt live with you, then the hatch wont be there of course
♡ sprites made by me. i did have to change/remove some aspects of the original castle to make it fit, so hopefully it still looks like peach's castle!
